summary.zh: agent-pack：MCP 条目里的 ${HOME} 等系统变量不再被当作凭据键，同步时展开为本机路径；合并多个来源时 ${PLUGIN_ROOT} 按各自来源解析，引用的文件找不到时 sync 与 doctor 阻塞并指出条目与路径。
summary.en: agent-pack: system variables such as ${HOME} in MCP entries are no longer treated as credential keys and are expanded to this machine's paths at sync; with several mcp_sources, ${PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves per source, and sync and doctor block with the entry and path when the referenced file is missing.
